as_told.title: String theory as a blocking mechanism against dangerous physics

plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels has asked whether string theory, a popular idea in physics that Ed Witten, a leading physicist, worked on, might be a deliberate "bridge to nowhere". The mathematician Eric Weinstein makes the same claim his own, saying it may have been a blocking mechanism to keep people from doing dangerous physics work, and he links it to an account of hidden physics from the tech investors Andreessen and Horowitz, naming Witten and the physicist Brian Greene. If true, it would mean mainstream physics was steered away from secret discoveries on purpose.
